# id: # Magic methods from the OSRS Wiki training pages and the Ironman / Ultimate Ironman guides (see source). "?" = rate not on the wiki; "our estimate" = xp per hour divided by xp each.

name: Splashing Wind Strike for AFK Magic xp
where: AFK splashing spot (wiki suggests Wizards' Tower top floor at -64 Magic attack)
note: Free-to-play guide gives 7,200 xp/h at about 5.5 xp per cast; the mind-rune count is our estimate (7,200 / 5.5) and the spell needs about -55 Magic attack bonus.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Magic training, Free-to-play Magic training, Ironman Guide/Magic, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Magic 2026-11-11

name: Lvl-1 Enchant on sapphire or opal jewellery

name: Casting Low Level Alchemy on cheap items
note: Pay-to-play guide gives up to about 60,000 xp/h standing still at 31 xp per cast, much lower while doing other tasks; no rune cost per hour is stated.
